steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Kami?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Yeah. I think all the funny stuff going on around Mitsukue has been tricks played by these kami-sama. And I'm looking for one of the many out there.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: You don't believe me?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oni are more familiar into monastery-type stuff.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Besides, I'm finding it hard to guess what sort of kami-sama would be so bored as to hop on a unicycle and curse my house.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Haha, sounds like most other Oni I know.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Why are you looking for this 'kami-sama'? Do you think one of them's cursed you?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: The opposite, actually. Did me a solid once.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: But one day, It just vanished.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Could it be the Wanyuudou?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Maybe? Can't say for sure. After all, I can't tell what the unicycling kami-sama looks like.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: So, mind doing me a favor?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: If you see the Wanyuudou, or are even... lucky enough to see Its actual form, help me check if It looks like this.
Moriuchi pulls out a ring of keys from his pocket, with a tiny keychain attached.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: A maneki-neko? Isn't that a mascot Higashinese Felines created based on Feline Beast Stewards?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: The kami-sama I met practically looks the same, apart from the size difference.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Hoshiguma-san, since you're no ghost, then I wager you're after this Wanyuudou to figure out what's up with your house, yeah?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Taishou, I never introduced myself to you.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Are you one of the Kinsekikai?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: (Shakes head) Naw. Why would anyone from the Kinsekikai set up a yatai here?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: An informant for the cops, then?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: (Shakes head) Rather throw my life away.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: An information broker.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: (Does not nod or shake head)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ha, I mean, what kind of intel guy would admit he's in the business?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But if you're in the business, then I don't think it's fair for you to ask me for help without offering anything in return.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Hah. What sort of reward would you like, Hoshiguma-san? If it's information, I can tell you all I know.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Don't worry about it. We can come back to that once I figure out what kind of information I'm after.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Anything that would cost you your life if you talked about it? Best to let me know beforehand. Last minute confessions won't get you any help from me.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: No, if you really manage to find me a useful clue or two, nothing's off the table.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Deal?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Deal.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Alright. So, where should I go looking for that Wanyuudou? A shrine?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Don't forget, the city under us isn't called 'Nan'in Anzai Mitsukueooyashiro' for nothing. This is the Southern Court's De-Facto Capital Mitsukue Grand Shrine. You can't possibly want me to go on a whole pilgrimage route?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Of course not. Do you know where's the place locals call Kizuna Jinja, the shrine of bonds?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Heard a bit about that one.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Though, if you know exactly which one to go to, why haven't you gone yourself?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Kamigami are fickle beings. They'll willingly appear before some, but won't grace others, no matter what.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And you're part of that 'other' group?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Seems so, ever since that kami left me.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Taishou! My scooter's all busted! Help me fix it before the guys chasing me catch up!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: EEK! WHY ARE YOU HERE?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Still think I'm a ghost, huh?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Wait, so, you're not?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: *Sigh*

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Momoka? What's with the panic?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I'm being chased! I rode my scooter here and shook them off, but it broke down. Could you get it running again?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Who's after you?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: It's... It's Mio-san...

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Mio? Then you best be good and follow her home. Overstep your calorie count again?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: No, she wants to... get rid of me!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: My TV suddenly freaked out and started broadcasting scary stuff!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: She was talking to Mifune-san! They said—Death or Oripathy! Tasukete!

spans.text: She was talking to Mifune-san! They said—Death or Oripathy!

steps.text: Momoka starts to babble incoherently.
Moriuchi has no time to react before Hoshiguma walks over to the scooter.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Death? Oripathy? Momoka-san, did you offend them somehow?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: All I did was to post one message, I wasn't planning anything or scheming with Tessai, nuh-uh!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Scheming with Tessai?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Let's see if this ride's fixable.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Why don't you go after the Wanyuudou first?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Playing dumb, information broker-san?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: This is my second time scaring Momoka-san here. She's in a pinch now, so I should do what I can to even the score.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Momoka-san, I promise you as long as I'm here, nothing will happen to you.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Sankyuu...

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: —Someone's coming from Nita Street! Are they after me?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Kinsekikai outfits... seems to be the case.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Taishou! Ghost-san! Save me!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ghost-san? Me?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Sorry, I still don't know your name...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That aside, your ride's back in action.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hop on, and leave the rest to me.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Ghost-san!

steps.name: Fierce Yakuza
steps.text: Oh, so here you are, Momo-cchi.

steps.name: Fierce Yakuza
steps.text: Be a good girl and come on home with us, yeah? Play nice and we won't hurt you.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Wh-Where's Mio-san? I want to talk to her!

steps.name: Fierce Yakuza
steps.text: What'cha trying to do, huh? Negotiate with us?

steps.name: Fierce Yakuza
steps.text: For real, just be good and come on back with us. Then we'll forget everything that happened today. Keep running, and I can't say for sure that your pretty face won't have some new scars by the time we're done playing hide-and-seek.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Better worry about yourselves first.

steps.name: Fierce Yakuza
steps.text: And just who d'you think you are?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Go, Momoka. I'll handle them.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I can't leave you here all by yourself!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Then keep the back seat empty for me.

steps.name: Fierce Yakuza
steps.text: *Indecipherable tongue-click* I don't care who you are, or the bluff you're trying to pull, usero!

spans.text: *Indecipherable tongue-click* I don't care who you are, or the bluff you're trying to pull,

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Start the engine!

steps.name: Fierce Yakuza
steps.text: Omae! Don't think you're getting away!
Momoka revs the engine, and the one-horned Oni jumps onto the scooter's back seat as the yakuza's weapon swings through the air.

steps.name: Fierce Yakuza
steps.text: Chikushou! Fire! FIRE! Fill that pesky Oni and her ride with holes!

spans.text: Fire! FIRE! Fill that pesky Oni and her ride with holes!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: What do we do?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Just keep riding as fast as you can. Leave everything else to me.
Momoka is unable to take in her words. She was already hyperventilating before, and her fear turns her into a sobbing mess.
But through her tears, she realizes the lack of crossbow bolts flying past her. She hears only the sound of metal crashing into metal behind her, and the dull thump of bodies hitting something.
She does not know what's going on behind, and can't let go of her worries, so she can only cry as she turns her head around—
Bolts, daggers, and desperate punks, all slamming into Ghost-san's shield.
The shield stands only half a person's height, but in the single-horned Oni's hands it is practically a wall behind her scooter.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I'm gonna turn!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Don't worry about me. You'd ridden this fast before?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: OnlywhenfilminganditwasfakeIDON'THAVEACHOICEANYWAYS!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What did they teach you when you were filming?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: C-Countersteer, then lean in...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Yeah, just do that.
Momoka wails even louder as she imagines failing to pull off a countersteer.
She can already picture a scenario in her head where she pushes too hard, sending Ghost-san and herself flying straight into the yakuza's hands—

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: AhhhhHHHHWHATEVER!!!
Sparks fly from the vehicle, but it still manages a thrilling turn around the corner.
Now going straight, Momoka bites her lip, and grips the throttle tightly. The tremendous velocity even blows her tears off her face into the breeze.
The clamor of their pursuers gradually fades away.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Where are you going? I'll make sure you get there safe and sound, before I head over to the shrine to help the Taishou out.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Did Moriuchi-san... ask you to do something?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: To chase a kaidan I saw with my own eyes. A unicycle ridden by an invisible being. Told me to look for it at the shrine.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It appeared next to me in the middle of the night, and I chased it all the way to his yatai, before you came to us.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: In the middle of the night... a k-kaidan...?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Scared? Then let's split up.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: No, I'll go with you. I can't go home anymore, much less the agency...

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: There's... nowhere else for me to go.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I can't go with you?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You can. But keep your voice down, or you'll draw in those guys again. Done with all your screaming now? Does your throat hurt?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Not at all! I've had vocal training, you know! Even when I'm not on stage, I do as I'm taught to prevent damage to my vocal chords!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That so?

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: You're... back?

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Just doing a bit of work... brought something back here.

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Did Kinbee ask you to send me something again? I won't be able to use it, so go back and leave me to my work.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Hoshiguma's shield. 'Hannya', right?

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: You met her?

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Even if I didn't, I've heard enough of her from you over the past few years.

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Take that strange mask off your face.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Why do you care what I wear?

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Didn't Kinbee tell you to put that on when you went over to his place?

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: I said you were too honest with your emotions, and lack the composure of a leader. All you did was throwing tantrums at home and scratching the shoji screen doors with your worthless bokutou.

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: He tells you to hide your emotions, and you put this on like a good boy? Do you even know what could be hiding inside that mask?

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: I don't care if it's rigged with bombs and blows up my face one day, it's none of your business.

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Omae!

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Leave. I want you and your lousy mask out of my sight.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Leave? Me? What about my mother?

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: What about her?

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Today is the day she died, Chairman Tessai!

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Today?!

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: You forgot everything. All you think about is your reopened forge.

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: That's no excuse for you to hang around with that viper Kinbee.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Viper? And how did Kaa-san die again? What did he do when she died? What did you do? If he's a viper, what does that make you?

spans.text: Viper? And how did Kaa-san die again? What did he do when she died? What did
do? If he's a viper, what does that make you?

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Shut up—

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: What are Kaa-san and I to your Kinsekikai?!

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Forget it, there's nothing for us to discuss.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: I'm going in to pay my respects to her. Don't get in my way.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: What—

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Mifune-san... showing up on TV after all these years?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: That was a fun pachinko sesh! Tomorrow, I gotta run over to the shrine, so today... up the stairs to my room, and it's time to catch some Zs!

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: I lost seven thousand five hundred mon today. That means, for the rest of the month I still have...

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Huh. Barely enough to get by.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Alright. Well, I should've asked Old Man Tessai for my pay for looking after the parlor.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: As long as I don't think about how much I've lost, pachinko's always a fun time.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Face wash done, TV's on, terminal charging...

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: News jacking? What's going on?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Wait, why's he—
Kichisei jumps up from her futon and stares at the screen in shock.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Kinbee?!
Logs, cache, hardware traces...
All traces clean.
From terminal placements to signal hijacking and the aftermath... the whole process took about... two hours?
Everything that had to be verified's done. The broadcast, linking to live monitors, and live subtitles. All okay.
There were minor glitches from signal fluctuations, but they weren't anything unmanageable. A little workaround here and there and it should be all good to go next time. Kanpeki!

spans.text: There were minor glitches from signal fluctuations, but they weren't anything unmanageable. A little workaround here and there and it should be all good to go next time.

steps.text: I'm so tired. I wanna sleep.
Locking in for two hours straight is my limit. I'm so sleepy.
No, I can't sleep here. Even a Kinseki Channel employee taking a nap in here would be pretty suspicious.
I have to go back to that cramped and lousy office—
Huh? An interim broadcast?
Uh oh! I gotta hide!

steps.name: Tired Staff
steps.text: Yes, I'm here. Let me test the machine...

steps.name: Tired Staff
steps.text: What? No, I'm the only one in here.

steps.name: Tired Staff
steps.text: Right, yes.

steps.name: Tired Staff
steps.text: All's set in place. The broadcast can start at any time.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Mio-san? What a rare sight.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: I recommend the chikuwa, but the burdenbeast tendons and fowlbeast eggs are must-tries too. If you fancy something lighter, may I suggest our daikon or konbu knots—

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Don't play dumb, Moriuchi. Where's Momoka and the Ao-Oni?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: How would I know?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Just give me a number. The Kinsekikai can afford it.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: I only sell oden here. How could I possibly know where my customers go after filling their bellies?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: An appropriate pushback is understandable, but an excessive defiance means refusal to cooperate.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: No, no, I would never.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: I don't get it, s'all. She's just a showgirl at your mercy, without any kin in the city. Where could she possibly run off to? What harm could she do to your Kinsekikai?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Are you trying to pull information out of me?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: I wouldn't dare.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Mio-san, I'm sure you've known her for a long time, even longer than I've known her.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: She got to know me because my oden's yummy, and I know all about the kaidan in the city. I only offered a few comforting words and to be honest, we're not that close at all.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: But I can tell she's just a lost little lass being pushed around with no bad intentions. I'm sure you've spent way more time with her, so what say you?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: I see you're insisting on your silence.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: C'mon, let's not put it that way.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: How about, helping me leave a good review for this spot? Something about this place being a rare gem, and a great bang for your buck.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Why not have some oden to appease your hunger and mood?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Chikuwa, tendon, egg, daikon, and konbu knot. One of each.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Mio-san, you...?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: So you had no intention of giving me a free meal? I see how it is. Fine for Momoka, but not for me.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: What? No! I just thought you'd never allow me the honor of serving you my humble cooking.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Here you go.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Itadakimasu.
She claps her hands and dips her head before her meal, then takes the chikuwa from the paper cup for a nibble.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: It's hot—
The noise echoing down Nita Street suddenly dips in volume.
Pedestrians fall silent at the exact same moment, like fowlbeasts on a single tree suddenly stopping their chirping.
But the silence only lasts a few seconds before a uniform voice booms from every television screen on the street.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Good evening, citizens of Mitsukue.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: I'm terribly sorry for taking up your time. I, Kouhei Mifune, have news to break to you all.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: When's the last time your boss showed his face on a program?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: More than a decade ago.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: ...The singer and actress Momoka Hanyuu, is currently missing.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: I repeat, the whereabouts of popular singer and actress Momoka Hanyuu, who has a long-term contract with our company, are currently unknown.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: According to reliable sources, Momoka-san's disappearance is closely linked to the kaidan tales circulating in the city.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: We are still verifying how they are related to the situation, but we are certain of one thing, at the core of this strange incident is...

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: The 'Ao-Oni of Kinsekikai', the 'Single-horned Oni', among many more nicknames.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: A female Oni with one horn, long green hair, of tall and sturdy build. Said to carry a large triangular shield.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: She vanished two decades ago, spawning the myth that she was haunting the city as a vengeful spirit late at night, killing anyone who'd been connected with her.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Many attendees report seeing this individual at Momoka-san's concert.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: As for whether she is truly a living being, a pretender, or a genuine ghost—we are as yet uncertain.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: As the man responsible for the company Momoka-san is contracted to, I make a sincere appeal for the general public to contact us with any clues. You will be rewarded handsomely.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: I'm sure Momoka-san also harbors hope that you will help her out of her plight...

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Just... for that? To find Momoka and the Ao-Oni?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: What did they even do to provoke Mifune?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: None of your business.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: I don't get it, Mio-san. Is this lass really worth your boss getting so worked up?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: They've got Mifune casting such a wide net over the city, woven of every pair of eyes glued to the TV—
Moriuchi sees a flash of something.
A tantou.
In the same instant he lacked any time to respond, the short blade stabs into the wooden oden table.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: If you choose to be silent, then it's best you stay silent. Not even a word. Remember this well.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: It would be very sad to see your oden disappear from this city.
